Marquis Sling Bag Shoulder Sleeve Made for 14″ MacBooks – Blue

The Marquis Sling Bag Shoulder Sleeve Made for 14″ MacBooks is designed for professionals, students, and travelers who want a sleek, lightweight, and protective solution for carrying their laptop. Crafted under the Marquis Series, this premium shoulder sleeve combines modern aesthetics with practical functionality, making it an ideal everyday carry for Apple MacBook users.

With a refined blue Colour and minimalist design, this sling bag perfectly complements the premium look of your MacBook. It is precisely engineered to fit laptops with a standing screen display size of 14 inches, ensuring a snug and secure fit while remaining slim and easy to carry.

Designed for 14-Inch MacBooks

This sleeve is purpose-built for 14-inch MacBooks, including the latest MacBook Pro models. The internal dimensions and padding provide reliable protection against daily wear, minor bumps, and scratches, while maintaining a lightweight profile. With product dimensions of 40 x 30 x 6 cm, it offers ample space without unnecessary bulk.

The compact item height of 6 centimeters and item width of 30 centimeters allow the bag to sit comfortably against your body when worn as a sling or shoulder bag. Whether you are commuting to work, attending meetings, or traveling, this sleeve ensures convenience and comfort throughout the day.

Lightweight Yet Durable Construction

Weighing only 180 g, the Marquis sling bag is exceptionally lightweight, making it easy to carry for long hours without strain. Despite its light weight, the bag is constructed using durable, high-quality materials that provide long-lasting performance.

The sturdy zipper closure ensures your MacBook stays securely inside, while the smooth interior lining helps prevent scratches on your device. The exterior fabric is designed to resist everyday dust and minor spills, offering dependable protection for daily use.

Comfortable Sling & Shoulder Carry

The adjustable shoulder strap allows you to customize the fit according to your preference, offering flexibility for sling or shoulder carry. This makes the Marquis MacBook sleeve an excellent choice for users who prefer hands-free mobility without compromising on style.

Its slim silhouette makes it easy to pair with both casual and professional outfits, making it suitable for office use, college, business travel, and daily commuting.

Key Features & Specifications

  • Series: Marquis
  • Product Type: Sling Bag / Shoulder Sleeve
  • Compatible Device: 14-inch MacBooks
  • Standing Screen Display Size: 14 Inches
  • Colour: Blue
  • Product Dimensions: 40 x 30 x 6 cm
  • Item Height: 6 Centimeters
  • Item Width: 30 Centimeters
  • Item Weight: 180 g
  • Lightweight and slim design
  • Durable zipper and premium fabric
  • Comfortable adjustable shoulder strap

Why Choose the Marquis Sling Bag?

The stands out for its balance of protection, portability, and premium design. Unlike bulky laptop bags, this sleeve offers a streamlined profile while still keeping your MacBook safe and secure. It is an excellent choice for users searching for a lightweight laptop sleeve that aligns with modern lifestyle needs. Its thoughtful design and trusted quality make it a reliable companion for everyday use.
